diagram_review.existing_diagram_checks: No embedded TikZ diagrams or diagram assets occur in the 159 assigned sources; screenshot metadata reports tikz_count=0 and diagram_failures=0 throughout. The two occurrences of “diagram” in source refer to abstract Mayer–Vietoris commutative diagrams, not rendered figures. No existing diagram map/orientation/index/sign claims were available to validate.

candidates.kind: TikZ circle map / signed regular fibre
candidates.why_warranted: The counterexample’s central claim is that a regular value has two preimages with opposite local signs. The source gives the map, circle orientations, exact fibre and derivative signs; a small schematic would make the unsigned-versus-signed count immediate.
candidates.specific_content: Draw source and target circles with counterclockwise orientation, the target regular value 1, its two source preimages θ=0 and θ=π, and local orientation labels +1 and −1. Mark their signed sum 0 and unsigned count 2. Keep it schematic; do not suggest the map covers the whole target (its phase range is [-1,1]).
candidates.status: source-supported candidate; no diagram currently exists; content checked against explicit formula and derivatives

candidates.why_warranted: The statement identifies a nontrivial open star-shaped subset of one tangent space by direction-dependent cut times and maps it diffeomorphically to the complement of the base point and cut locus. The proof separately establishes openness, injectivity, surjectivity, local diffeomorphism, and image exclusions; a paired schematic can orient readers through the set correspondence.
candidates.specific_content: Show a tangent-space disk-like radial domain D_p with origin removed and radial endpoints at c_p(v), plus a manifold-side schematic with p and Cut(p) removed. Indicate exp_p as a bijective local diffeomorphism from D_p onto that open complement. Label boundary at cut time excluded and avoid implying the cut locus is smooth or that exp_p extends injectively to it.
candidates.status: source-supported candidate; mathematical interpretation confirmed from statement and proof; schematic geometry only

visual_review.source_snapshot_html_tile_hashes: All 159 assignment source hashes, frozen snapshot hashes and HTML hashes match exactly; all 208 tile hashes match their screenshot metadata SHA256.
visual_review.rendering: Displayed inline and display math, including subscripts, superscripts, Greek letters, matrices and large expressions, was legible in the opened original-resolution tiles. Wikilink titles appearing as separate block lines were treated as expected. CSS technique banners use the expected uppercase styling; three banners leak raw MathMarkdown as listed above.
visual_review.clipping: No confirmed clipping. Every assigned tile was opened standalone at original resolution. Multi-tile pages use overlapping vertical slices (capture metadata), so content beginning/ending at a tile edge is treated as continuation; checked examples showed the continuation on adjacent tiles.
visual_review.reference_title_leaks: No repository IDs or unintended reference-title leaks observed. Rendered reference titles are intentional block-line links.
math_map_orientation_checks: cex-a-map-with-two-preimages-but-degree-zero: counterclockwise S1 orientations and derivative signs at [0],[1/2] are +1,-1; degree 0 versus two points is consistent.

ex-gauss-bonnet-for-a-spherical-cap: the boundary is positively oriented by increasing longitude for the north cap; with the library quarter-turn/sign convention kg=cot(theta0)/R, its boundary contribution 2πcos(theta0) and curvature contribution 2π(1−cos(theta0)) sum to 2π.
prop-angle-derivative-formula-for-geodesic-curvature: the displayed frame convention yields kg=theta′+omega(T), consistent with JT and the connection one-form sign in the supplied frame.
thm-weingarten-equation-and-adjointness-of-the-shape-operator: checked the convention S_vX=−(nabla_Xv)^T against the split nabla_Xv=−S_vX+nabla-perp_Xv and g(S_vX,Y)=g(II(X,Y),v); signs agree.
visual_review.limitations: Review was local to the frozen assignment and its item source/snapshot/HTML/tiles. No live site or HTTP access. Review is visual and targeted, not a comprehensive mathematical audit of every proof.
